name: Pecans
siboNotes: Pecans are naturally FODMAP-free and generally well-tolerated. High fat content may slow digestion in some sensitive individuals.
preparationTips: Store in refrigerator or freezer to prevent rancidity due to high oil content
Toast lightly to enhance flavor and improve digestibility
Choose raw or dry-roasted varieties over flavored options which may contain FODMAP ingredients
Chop or grind for easier digestion if experiencing sensitivity
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of vitamin E and manganese
